comparison_with_older_C05.original_ref: Tolsa (2017), ZPE 203 pp 192–198, from Jones (1999) papyrus edition
comparison_with_older_C05.caution: Verifying original papyrus identity and visually inspecting a photo is distinct from independently reading fragmentary Greek and numerical assignments. C05 comparative arithmetic is unchanged.
comparison_with_older_C05.scholarly_alternative_explorations: Tolsa tested Paulus ch32, Olympiodorus and Valens plus mixed hypotheses; none may be retrospectively admitted as empirical success.

separate_categories.zodiacal_place: C06 independently identified Leo 22°11′ -> Virgo comparing Tolsa/Valens VIII.7; NOT the same doctrine as three monomoiria labels
separate_categories.zodiacal_terms_and_triplicity: Do not pool terms, signs, segments, lots, triplicity as repeated validations of same monomoiria method
separate_categories.documentary_historical_computation: not prospective human prediction; this papyrus is an ancient horoscope and does not imply that its chart predicts anyone's personality
